# doc-to-adoc

`doc-to-adoc` is a Node.js ESM library and CLI that converts document, spreadsheet, markup, and image files into canonical AsciiDoc for technical writing, RAG pipelines, and automated documentation workflows. It targets JavaScript/TypeScript projects and resolves a wide range of file formats into a single normalized output.

```typescript
import { convert } from "doc-to-adoc";

const outputContentWithAdoc = await convert({
  inputFilePath: "./my.docx",
  toFormat: "adoc",
});

console.log(outputContentWithAdoc);
```

## Core API Overview

- `convert(options)` — Converts an input file to AsciiDoc and can pipe the result to Markdown or plain text via the AsciiDoc render step; defined in `src/converter.ts`.
- `ConvertOptions` — Public input contract for `convert`, requiring exactly one input source (`inputFilePath`, `inputString`, or `inputBuffer`) and optionally `toFormat`; defined in `src/converter.ts`.
- `src/index.ts` — Public package entrypoint that re-exports `convert`, `ConvertOptions` for ESM consumers.
- `bin/cli.js` / `src/cli.ts` — CLI wrapper that accepts `-i/--input`, `-o/--output`, `-t/--type`, `-f/--force`, `-v/--version`, and `-h/--help`.
- Format adapters — Native converters handle PDF, DOC/DOCX, CSV/TSV, XLS/XLSX/ODS, HTML, JSON/YAML/TOML/XML, Markdown, ODT, and RTF, with Pandoc selected when available for additional formats.

### Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Mistake: passing a path relative to the wrong working directory. Correct usage: resolve against `process.cwd()` or pass an absolute path before calling `convert`.

```typescript
import path from "node:path";

const outputContentWithMarkdown = await convert({
 inputFilePath: path.resolve("./docs/report.pdf"),
 toFormat: "markdown",
});
```

- Mistake: treating `toFormat: "txt"` as a bypass. The library still converts input to AsciiDoc first, then renders to plain text.

```typescript
const outputContentWithPlainText = await convert({
 inputFilePath: "./notes.md",
 toFormat: "text",
});
```

- Mistake: assuming every exotic format works without Pandoc. For `.latex`, `.rst`, `.org`, `.wiki`, and similar inputs, install Pandoc or use a supported native format.

```typescript
const asAsciiDoc = await convert({
 inputFilePath: "./guide.rst",
 toFormat: "adoc",
});
```
